parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Only plans of this canonical site (exact match).

parameters.name: path_id
parameters.description: Only plans evaluating this ProcessPath id (exact match).

parameters.name: window_start
parameters.description: Only plans whose window starts at this instant (RFC 3339; equal instants match in any zone). Malformed: 400 malformed-window-start.

parameters.name: window_end
parameters.description: Only plans whose window ends at this instant (RFC 3339). Malformed: 400 malformed-window-end; with window_start, an end that is not after the start is 400 invalid-capacity-window.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from the previous page's nextCursor. Repeat the filters on every page request.
